final_qi.question: Is it incorrect that the physician who currently occupies the Cullen Endowed Chair at Baylor College of Medicine was the first to describe Potocki-Lupski Syndrome?
final_qi.long_answer: James R. Lupski, M.D., Ph.D., currently holds the Cullen Foundation Endowed Chair in Molecular Genetics at Baylor College of Medicine. Together with Dr. Lorraine Potocki, he was the first to delineate the microduplication syndrome now known as Potocki-Lupski syndrome (17p11.2 microduplication) in the mid-1990s. Therefore the statement that the physician who presently occupies the Cullen Endowed Chair at BCM was the first to describe Potocki-Lupski syndrome is factually correct, not incorrect.
